notes: Final leaf of the second Coates letter, pencil folio 49. It proposes an extra paragraph on the Weil conjectures, introduces A′ and A″, states a proposition relating them to C, and gives two degree factorizations. The visible second-condition indices are 2j and H^(j+2)(X), while its last group remains H^i(Y). The first condition has 2i in its bound and H^i in its groups. These mixed indices are retained. The superscript in ΛYφ+(x) has two crossing strokes and is transcribed +; no replacement by a pullback star was made. Typed crittval/critical, the overtyped proposition capital, and conjunction remain doubtful. The clear spelling Analoguous is restored. The two bottom chains were checked at their actual endpoints: in the even chain the changes are 0,+2,+2, giving total +4 from 2m−2 to 2m+2; the odd chain has changes 0,+2, giving total +2 from 2m to 2m+2. Using the explicitly written identity φ_*φ*=LX on the earlier leaves, the even composite is LXφ_*φ*=LX² and the odd composite is φ_*φ*=LX. This checks the displayed composites, not the proposition about the conjectures, whose proof was not supplied or independently established here. Source qualifications “rather trivial”, “trivially implied” and “pretendedly” remain the author’s wording. The earlier cancelled trace in the odd exponent is placed on the baseline between the two exponent portions, preserving its visible lower position.
